title: Testing Strategies & The Testing Trophy
summary: How to balance unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end flows for maximum confidence and minimal maintenance drag.
keyPrinciples: Test behavior, not implementation details: refactoring internals should not break valid tests.
Focus heavily on integration tests: testing units together provides the highest ROI per engineering hour.
Avoid over-mocking: mocked dependencies drift from real behavior and hide critical contract bugs.

rules.title: Test User-Observable Outputs Rather Than Internal Component State
rules.description: Asserting on internal state variables couples tests to private implementation details. Assert on what the user or caller actually perceives.

badExample.explanation: If you refactor the component to use a reducer or context, the test breaks even if the UI still works.

goodExample.explanation: Tests the software exactly the way actual human users and screen readers experience it.

productionChecklist: Fast unit tests run in <10 seconds locally before commit.
Integration tests use real test database containers (Testcontainers) instead of fake in-memory mocks.
Critical checkout and authentication flows covered by automated E2E tests (Playwright).
Flaky tests quarantined immediately to preserve CI build trust.
